source_text: Ordo amoris in Libro II: a confessione infirmitatis (nigra sum) ad petitionem scientiae (indica mihi), a cognitione sui ad assimilationem equitatui divino, a memoria passionis (myrrha) ad laudem pulchritudinis sponsi. Gradus animae proficientis hic designantur.
pass_a_gloss: Order of-love in Book II: from confession of-weakness (black I-am) unto petition of-knowledge (indicate to-me)...
pass_b_english: The order of love in Book II: from confession of weakness (I am black) to petition for knowledge (tell me), from self-knowledge to likeness to the divine cavalry, from memory of the passion (myrrh) to praise of the Bridegroom’s beauty. The steps of the advancing soul are marked here.
